rv.q: Superbly directed by Webster, it is full of wolfish imagination and alarming surprise.
This production is perfectly crafted to give you an unforgettable experience; both visually and audibly.
Ash Hunter was both sinister and sensational, his aura had the audience in suspense.
Jackson manages to inject suspense into a story most audiences will be familiar with...
Leach’s Macbeth was already beyond blemish in 2022 and is even better in 2024.

cn.t: Critics praise this immersive, high-concept Macbeth for its inventive staging and atmospheric design. The production captivates with creative elements like binaural headphones and striking visuals that breathe fresh life into Shakespeare's classic.
